review:
Sugar Merge Up gives the Merge Up 2 engine a candy makeover with relaxing pop-style ASMR sounds. Jelly bears and bubblegum stacks fill the grid, and symbols merge into higher levels after each win.

The main addition is the new Booster modes, which can fill the grid with cell multipliers of up to 128x from the very first spin, raising the potential right away for a higher price. There are three bonus buy modes where permitted, plus a feature that slightly raises the bet for better odds. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins are rare, around once every 409 spins on average.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
